limits: Structural pairs match checked_receipt supported object/map shapes; textual matches are candidates, not proof of active runtime consumption.
JSONL and non-JSON text checked only by path+hash co-occurrence. Nested snapshots/copies and >2MB blobs excluded as recorded.
Sidecar-mediated closure is prospective: every affected consumer must be classified; custom raw-hash checks may need a separate new study rather than archive redirection.
No build, compiled call, shared edit, archival installation or scientific acceptance.
